summary: Convert technical book PDFs into interactive Claude Code skills using LLM context engineering and RAG, enabling study, reference, and on-the-job usage.
usecases: Transform technical textbooks into study-ready AI skills for self-paced learning.
Enable developers to query and reference book content as code-executable skills during work.
Build a knowledge base from PDFs for RAG-powered assistants and code-aware tutoring.
ideas: Integrate with VS Code extension for inline code examples from book content.
Create a marketplace of book-to-skills for different tech stacks.
Combine with voice assistants for hands-free learning while coding.
